game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Smoke Ridge, a ridge shrouded in ash: the ember mage must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Modulo Gate: Use % to decide which gates in Smoke Ridge open (even, odd, divisible by 3).
theme: Mt. Pyre – Smoke Ridge: a ridge shrouded in ash
core_gameplay_loop: In Smoke Ridge, repeat each round: Use % to decide which gates in Smoke Ridge open (even, odd, divisible by 3). Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the gates_open value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the magma valve using at most 22 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The magma valve reached with actions_used <= 22.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 22 before the magma valve is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 9 (extended tier): Modulo Gate
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Modulo Gate' (Week 2 slot 3), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Smoke Ridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gates_open changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Smoke Ridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The magma valve reached with actions_used <= 22.
